summary: Framegrabs from the Oct 2020 v10 orca-candidate review. All 16 detections >=+1.16 were reviewed by ear; NO identifiable orca found (~14 humpback, 2 other). These images illustrate the humpback/other false-positive candidates in peak-humpback October. Confirms Oct 2020 acoustic silence for orca under the more-sensitive v10 model, strengthening the 'seen but not heard' interpretation.
confidence: These are NOT orca. Illustrative false-positive/other examples.
